purpose: Primary-source evidence for independent driver research. Rate, power and BER stay scoped to each experiment. Null values mean unavailable at the checked read depth.

sources.title: 10.5 Gbps Visible Light Communication Systems Based on C-Plane Freestanding GaN Micro-LED
sources.locator: Abstract, device-size sweep and extended-distance sentence
sources.limits: Abstract does not establish the geometry definition, per-size bias, per-size maximum-rate distance, FEC, BER, or energy boundary. The 60 um optimum is specific to this setup.

sources.title: Transfer-printed yellow and red InGaN micro-LEDs on diamond for ultra-low-power high-speed optical interconnects
sources.read_depth: Primary full text available through publisher indexing and previously verified full-text extraction
sources.locator: Fig. 4; Fig. 5c–o; Results (optical interconnection tests); Measurement method

evidence.emitter: square yellow/red InGaN, transfer-printed to diamond, microlensed
evidence.ook_receiver: approx. 1 GHz Hamamatsu C5658 APD, DSA capture and MATLAB processing
evidence.ook_ber_scope: Amplitude swept while maintaining BER below author's FEC threshold; separate setup from small-signal measurement

sources.limits: The receiver limited the OOK experiment to 1.5 Gb/s. LED DC estimate excludes the RF driver, modulated energy, and receiver. OFDM and OOK conditions are distinct. Derived current is J times geometric square area.

sources.title: Supporting data for Transfer-printed yellow and red InGaN micro-LEDs on diamond for ultra-low-power high-speed optical interconnects

sources.title: GaN Micro-LEDs for Chip-to-Chip Interconnects

single_lane.substrate: passive polished sapphire with GSG and externally driven 50 ohm AC coupling
single_lane.energy_scope: LED average current times applied voltage divided by line rate, excludes integrated driver estimate

sources.limits: The paper reports open eyes to 12 Gb/s; BER claim quoted here refers to 10 Gb/s. A faster stand-alone emitter is distinct from the tested integrated driver or the array.

sources.title: 200G VCSEL Development and Proposal of Using VCSELs for Near-Package-Optics Scale-Up Application

sources.title: Transverse detuned loading for modulation bandwidth enhancement in VCSELs

evidence.emitter: 850 nm single-mode VCSEL, transverse detuned loading
evidence.mode: NRZ, PRBS13, back-to-back, no DSP/pre-emphasis/receiver equalization

sources.limits: Eye-statistics BER estimate, not long bit-count BER. FEC threshold comparison, not deployed FEC. Fitted roll-off extrapolates beyond the instrument measurement span. External AWG and probe; no production ASIC evidence.
